name: smda-automation
description: Standalone SMDA Scheduler runtime, Tier-3 setup skill, and MCP operator tools for State-Machine-Driven Automation, packaged for Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Set up SMDA config with bundled runtime-backed MCP tools.
interface.longDescription: Provides the bundled SMDA Scheduler runtime, its product-owned MCP operator server, and setup-smda-automation, a Tier-3 config skill for wiring an existing Engineering Codex development harness or equivalent repo context substrate to SMDA. It adds SMDA-specific routing, config, quality-gate, and operator pointers only; it never vendors engine, adapter, schema, report, or generic harness code into the target repo.
defaultPrompt: Set up SMDA automation in this repo against the SMDA Scheduler product.
Refresh the SMDA Tier-3 config and check it against the product contracts.
Use the bundled SMDA MCP tools to inspect runtime status.
